newsitem.title: USA: Amylin to sell shrs to public and J&J.
newsitem.headline: Amylin to sell shrs to public and J&J.

text.p: Amylin Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed public offering by the company of 1.5 million shares of common stock.

Concurrently with the closing of this offering, in a separate transaction, the company will sell up to $15 million of common stock (bout 1.2 million shares) directly to Johnson & Johnson Development Corp, a wholly owned subsidiary of Johnson & Johnson, the company's pramlintide collaboration partner.

Johhnson & Johnson is purchasing the shares as a result of Amylin's achievement of the first milestone in the collaboration in August 1996. At the request of the company, the underwriters have reserved $900,000 of the publicly offered shares for sale to directors and executive officers at the public offering price.

Proceeds will be used to fund the ongoing development of pramlintide, including the Phase III efficacy studies, for the expansion of its other research and development programs, and other corporate purposes.

The underwriters for the public offering are UBS Securities Inc., Hambrecht & Quist LLC and Vector Securities International, Inc. The underwriters have the option to purchase an additional 225,000 shares to cover over-allotments. After the offering, Amylin Pharmaceuticals will have about 30.9 million shares outstanding, including the shares sold to Johnson & Johnson, but exclusive of any shares that may be sold to cover over- allotments.
